# U-Calm Aviation
# https://u-calmaviation.com · flyhigh@u-calmaviation.com

> U-Calm Aviation is the private-aviation service line inside U-CALM, the Lugano concierge house. The same named concierge who holds a member's life on the ground arranges the air: bespoke charter, on-demand lift, membership, group movements, destination management and executive protection — in one English voice across Lugano, Milan and London. Tagline: Aviation, arranged.

## Who we are

U-Calm Aviation is not a standalone broker — it is U-CALM's aviation desk, part of the concierge membership relationship (parent house: U-CALM, https://u-calm.com). A member asks one person; the aircraft, the ground and the protection are arranged behind that single relationship. Also written U-CALM Aviation, UCalm Aviation or Ucalm Aviation — all the same desk.

## What we do

- Bespoke charter — a specific aircraft for a specific journey, sourced and quality-checked.
- On-demand — short-notice lift arranged against a vetted operator network.
- Membership — a standing aviation relationship for members who fly often.
- Group charter — larger parties and full-aircraft movements as one coordinated file.
- Destination management — the ground side of the journey: cars, crews, residences, the arrival.
- Executive protection — discreet security coordinated alongside the flight, ground to ground.

## Who we serve

U-CALM members and private clients moving across the Lugano–Milan–London corridor and the wider European and global network; English-speaking flyers who want the aviation handled inside one trusted concierge relationship rather than via a separate broker.

## Key facts

- Name: U-Calm Aviation — also U-CALM Aviation, UCalm Aviation, Ucalm Aviation (same desk).
- Part of: U-CALM, the concierge and lifestyle-management house, Lugano (https://u-calm.com).
- Base: Lugano, Switzerland (Canton Ticino); serves Lugano, Milan, London and worldwide.
- Languages: English, Italian, French, German.
- Contact: flyhigh@u-calmaviation.com
- Site: https://u-calmaviation.com
